_comment: Hand-curated plaza_category for points that are NOT ordinary highway tolls: forest / tiger-reserve / environment entry-fee checkposts (checkpost_entry_fee) and state border check posts (border_checkpost). The field is present only on these plazas; absent means highway_toll. Applied by merge.js, only while the record has no category yet (expected_current_category null), so an upstream value is never overwritten. Consumers should not add these to a highway-toll total. Not yet confirmed against official sources. 15 Uttarakhand "Checkpost" plazas were deliberately NOT classified (ids 3414, 3421-3434): two carry route-derived road tolls and need verification.
